findings.old_text: Because Enforce Script has no closures or delegates, routing the result back by function name -- the target object plus a method name string -- is the standard way to give a reusable dialog a callback. Any admin-tool style dialog box that needs to hand a result back to an arbitrary caller uses this same name-based routing.
findings.final_new_text: This example routes results by target object and method name. DayZ also exposes `func` callbacks and `ScriptInvoker`; choose the callback mechanism supported by the API you are using and keep callback targets alive until the dialog finishes.
findings.reason: Pinned VideoWidget callback and ScriptInvoker APIs refute the universal name-string claim without asserting closures.
